title: A plan before slides
subtitle: Ask for a section and you get a storyboard to read first
bullets: The agent does not write slides yet. It writes a storyboard: one row per slide, with what each key press shows
It puts the storyboard in this deck's plan, under docs/plans, and shows it to you
Change the topic in the prompt to one you know well
task: Say this, with your own topic. Nothing in the deck changes yet, so this task cannot tick itself.
prompt: In the deck tutorial-agents, I want a new section with the id mine: three slides on how to brew good coffee. Write the storyboard first and show it to me before you build anything.
